name: _histogramdd_from_bin_cts
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_histogramdd_from_bin_cts(Tensor self, int[] bins, *, float[]? range=None, Tensor? weight=None, bool density=False) -> Tensor. Computes a histogram from per-dimension bin counts without mutating or aliasing inputs. Tests preserve base and autogenerated out coverage, explicit and automatic ranges, weights, density, boundary precision, empty input, many bins, non-finite and zero-width range behavior, out identity/storage/resize/dtype/noncontiguous behavior, and error contracts.
